summary: Siuslaw NF summit lookouts from 1913; the last tower, a 67-ft L-4 cab on a timber tower, was removed in 1978; no source describes the summit site today.

facts.design: Cupola cabin (1924), then a 53-ft L-4 tower (1937) and a 67-ft treated timber tower with L-4 cab (1950)
facts.status_note: Last tower removed in 1978; no source we read describes what remains on the summit today
facts.agency: U.S. Forest Service, Siuslaw National Forest

access.note: A 2013 Pew Trusts fact sheet says the Pioneer-Indian Trail is still in use by hikers today; no source we read describes the former lookout site today

visit.trail_note: Pioneer-Indian Trail, still used by hikers (Pew Trusts, 2013)

corrections.why: 9.1 m is 30 ft, the 1924 structure on the southwest summit. The last tower, removed in 1978, was 67 ft (about 20.4 m) per the register and Forest Lookouts.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register says a 30-foot platform stood on the southwest summit; Forest Lookouts calls it a 30-foot tower. The story says structure.
The December 1936 newsletter item says a tower was recently completed; the register and Forest Lookouts date the 53-foot tower to 1937. Both are kept in the story.
Pew (2013) calls the lookout a popular day hike, but the register, firelookout.com and Forest Lookouts all date the last tower's removal to 1978. The story says it is unclear what Pew means.

notes_for_editor: Correction proposed: the record's height_m 9.1 (30 ft) matches the 1924 structure, not the 67-ft tower removed in 1978. Coordinates in the record match the register's point (45.21987, -123.72479); the west_us_lookouts point listed in the brief's conflicts (45.2145, -123.755) was not checked. Elevation 961.3 m matches firelookout.com's 3154 ft. Pew's 3,175 ft is a rise, not an elevation. No source read describes the summit today; the editor may want a Siuslaw NF or on-site check.
